proposed_answer: PBDs are classified as purchased credit-impaired (POCI) financial assets (Stage 3) on initial recognition and measured at amortised cost using a credit-adjusted effective interest rate (weighted average 19.2% at 31 Mar 2026 vs 17.9% at 31 Mar 2025 vs 18.4% at 30 Sep 2025). Classification does not change even if cash flows return to contractual terms. Principal book net carrying R3,845m (Mar-26) vs R3,690m (Mar-25) vs R3,975m (Sep-25).
